content:
I'm surprised no one has suggested this yet. I often find a need to iterate over number ranges or Arrays in reverse.

I guess there are two approaches for this:

  • for types where iterating forward and backward both make sense, adapt the existing iterator types to support backward step as well, or
  • make separate backward iterators

Rust makes the first choice, but I believe it is totally OK to choose the second, as it is exceedingly rare to do both forward and backward iteration on a single iterator object.
You're not the only one, but we haven't come around to actually implementing reverse iterators. I'd welcome and review PRs for separate backward iterators, e.g. Array.iterRev.
